title: California contractor license revocation registers
question: Which monthly reports are available and where do row counts reconcile?
finding: 232 consecutive monthly reports cover 2007-07 through 2026-10. 150 PDFs were recovered from archived copies of the state website. The extracted row count agrees with the printed footer in 231 reports.
how: Read each monthly report, separate contractor and salesperson entries, and compare their sum with the printed total. Verify each archived PDF against the content digest in its capture index.
limits: A row records a dated event. A license can appear more than once. Appeals, stays, substitutions, exemptions and reinstatements require separate records. A matching footer checks the count only. Inspect the underlying image before using a scanned license number or name. An empty footer field means its value could not be verified.
